answer: Each of 515 aliases needs its own authority-backed record, and the live check behind each one makes bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The meadow is the wall and the vine is the gate: A gym check-in streak with club attestation works as the gate: check-ins spread over years at one club. A farm of 515 aliases must climb the wall 515 times, the sparrow ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
